_note: Corrections applied by scripts/library/build.mjs on top of source-UNREVIEWED.json, which is never edited. Each has a reason. Written by Claude 2026-11-10 for the coach to check in COACH_REVIEW.md.

hybrid-4/h4-c2.reason: Source week 8 gave 22 min for a session whose own steps add up to 27 (P0.1). Weeks 1 to 7 already add up and are kept. Week 8 (the lighter week) drops to 3 rounds instead of squeezing the same work into less time.

conditioning-3/c3-intervals.reason: Source scaled the minutes week by week (18 to 31) but kept 8 min warm-up + 4 rounds + cool-down, at least 28 min before cool-down, so weeks 1 to 5 and 8 could not be done as written (P0.1). Now the rounds change instead of the minutes: one round added every two weeks, reaching the source's 4 rounds in week 5, back to 2 in the lighter week 8. Warm-up 6 min and cool-down 4 min (beginner to intermediate). Totals stay within 2 to 3 min of the source's.
